content_html:
Watched #Tiger3 : Kabhi EID…..Kabhi DIWALI

BHAI ke movie binnaa….Festival hai AADHURI 😉😉

A Good Film by Salman after ages 🙏🙏🙏🙏 which makes it a Decent watch….when I say Decent its just because of the high dose of Spy Thrillers in Bollywood

When it comes to Bollywood Spy Thrillers and especially Yash Raj’s Spy Universe I don’t understand why they are so obsessed with Pakistan and this movie took it to a notch higher with Indian Raw Agent trying to uplift the Democracy in Pakistan 🙏. Though it sounds over the top but Anything is possible with Salman Bhai and at least for me it looked convincing 👍. Hope this is the last spyverse movie obsessed with Pakistan 🙏

I love Tiger Franchise for being the first fully commercial Top Star movie giving equal importance to Female Lead characterisation and good to see that they still continued doing that….as with any other Spy Movie tough the story line is wrapper thin and has its own flaws, The Action Scenes and the Actors chemistry make it up to a good watch if not must watch!!!

For the people who are comparing Tiger3 craze with Pathan, I just want to remind them that the craze for Pathaan was just for the fact that SRK os doing a spy thriller for the very first time and I wonder if he can pull the same craze for the next part of Pathan (if there is any) but Salman Khan doing that effortlessly even with 3rd Instalment of Tiger shows his command over masses and all he needs is to bend his back and select good scripts ( but a serious NO to TUBELIGHT 😉)

The only disappointment I had with this movie is with its Music…forget about Pathaan even the first two instalments of Tiger had very peppy songs….but these songs are 😏
